title: Measures to Protect Personal Data of Facebook Users in Singapore
what_it_is: Measures to Protect Personal Data of Facebook Users in Singapore

sections.label: PDPA and Facebook breach
sections.summary: PDPA requires organisations to notify purposes, obtain consent and secure personal data, and PDPC monitored Facebook's September 2018 security breach.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information and Minister-in-charge of Trade Relations (Mr S Iswaran)
sentences.text: Among other things, PDPA requires organisations to notify individuals of the purposes for which they are collecting, using or disclosing personal data, to obtain consent where required, and to make reasonable security arrangements to protect the personal data under their possession or control.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information and Minister-in-charge of Trade Relations (Mr S Iswaran)
sentences.text: The Personal Data Protection Commission (PDPC) monitors data breach incidents closely and will take appropriate enforcement actions if it assesses that PDPA has been breached.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information and Minister-in-charge of Trade Relations (Mr S Iswaran)
sentences.text: With respect to Facebook's security breach in September 2018, Facebook reported that a feature allowing Facebook users to see what their own profiles looked like to others had a vulnerability which enabled attackers to view Facebook users' accounts without permission.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information and Minister-in-charge of Trade Relations (Mr S Iswaran)
sentences.text: Upon learning of the security vulnerability, PDPC immediately contacted Facebook to request for additional details, such as whether Singapore users were affected and the measures Facebook was taking to prevent a recurrence of such vulnerabilities.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information and Minister-in-charge of Trade Relations (Mr S Iswaran)
sentences.text: PDPC ensured that Facebook alerted affected users and advised them of the steps they could take to protect themselves.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information and Minister-in-charge of Trade Relations (Mr S Iswaran)
sentences.text: PDPC is also closely monitoring that matter, including the investigation in the United States and other related developments and will assess whether further action is necessary.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information and Minister-in-charge of Trade Relations (Mr S Iswaran)
sentences.text: Users of Facebook and other social media platforms should make full use of these platforms’ security features to protect their personal data, such as selecting their preferred option in the privacy settings of social media platforms.
